faq.q: What is an AI product video generator?
faq.a: It turns a product photo into a short demo that shows the item, one operation or one useful detail.

faq.q: How is this different from image to video?
faq.a: Image to video adds motion to a still. A product demo focuses on an operation or buyer question.

faq.q: Can I use the demo on a store or product page?
faq.a: Yes. Download the demo and place it beside your product photos, then follow the marketplace or store media rules.

faq.q: Which video lengths can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. Pick the length that gives the operation a clear start and finish.

faq.q: Will the demo show my product accurately?
faq.a: Start with a clear full view and review the finished demo beside the real item before posting. Replace any result that drifts.

faq.q: Can I add the price and product name?
faq.a: Yes. Add exact names, prices and dates later in Canva, CapCut or your ad editor.

faq.q: Can I use a close-up operation shot?
faq.a: Yes. A close view helps shoppers inspect a latch, button, lid, seam or other useful detail.

faq.q: Can I use product demos for paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Download the demo, add campaign text in your editor and review the final ad before launch.

steps.sourceAlt: Your product: a ceramic mug filling the frame on a pure white background.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded product photo as the exact product reference. Keep its shape, color and label area unchanged. Show one clear operation in a bright, natural setting, ending with the feature held still for inspection. Steady product-demo camera and realistic light. Sound: the real action and quiet room tone; no text, logos or music.
